title: Shard-parallel fan-out — Incremental Result Streamer (Signature)
description:
Signature edition — an original Signature-authored completion, clearly labeled as Signature work and never presented as public record. The incremental result streamer refuses to make callers wait for the last result before seeing the first. As each shard, source, or ranking stage finishes, its results flow to the caller immediately, marked with their provenance and completeness state. This changes the feel of archive search from batch to conversation and lets downstream consumers — human or machine — start working, re-ranking, or canceling early. The contract is explicit: partial, ordered, resumable.

This record documents the shard-parallel fan-out approach: Query all shards concurrently and stream each shard's results the moment they arrive.
